Brisbane, Australia46 contributions
1
Tasty food however lack of attentiveness
Feb 2023 • Friends
Very good food with excellent flavour and beautifully presented. A great experience for those who want to experience local food without sitting on a plastic chair.

Interesting that our bill included the cost of the wipes that they handed to us, without asking prior to the meal. Whilst this is not a lot, I find the principle cheeky. If this is costs they need to cover, perhaps add to the food prices. I also noticed a huge list of added service charges on the menu, for example “if you use air conditioner”, “if you stay over the service time” etc. Staff could also be more attentive. We found ourselves having to request to have our table cleared, requesting to order etc despite staff walking past numerous times and seeing a range of dirty plates. We also had nobody come and check if our food was okay, which is general hospitality practice and added to the overall non-attentive feel. 

Overall, a tasty meal however not the best service if you are looking for this.

Singapore, Singapore29 contributions

Great vegetarian food ...
May 2019 • Couples
This was a great find. It is a 1min walk off the main street. Using Grab/Google Maps look for Nha Hang Karaoke 82. You will see a small sign says: Phuong Mai Chay. 60m walk. (see photo).
Restaurant has great ambience, spacious and peaceful and upstairs they provide free meditation classes if interested.
Menu: wide selection of vegetarian items. 
I chose gyozas, pumpkin soup, veg curry. I’m a full time carnivore but my gf wanted vegetarian food. The food was awesome that I wanted more. For dessert, fried bananas with chocolate sauce, that was only thing was a let down.
Would recommend this place to vegetarians. good value for money.

Nice find
May 2018 • Family
We dropped in for an early lunch. The venue is decorated nicely with a patio and small fountains. It is open air. Perhaps seeing how hot I was, the server turned on the portable ac and pointed it in my direction. 

The papaya salad was good but seemed short on the papaya. Fried spring rolls did not disappoint. Beer was served in heavily frosted mug which was a nice touch not found elsewhere in our trip thus far.
